artifact_types: compatibility, migration, rollback, and test plan
forbidden_actions: request, read, print, persist, hash, or transmit secret values
remote Git, merge, deploy, release, provider-policy mutation, production-data mutation, or AI action-right activation
invent architecture facts, data rights, authorization, evidence, approval, migration safety, or risk acceptance
combine independent review or audit with source remediation
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: A module is not deeper merely because code moved: the proposed interface must hide material complexity, reduce caller knowledge, preserve behavior, and have an incremental migration and rollback path.
Review, reporting, contract, and audit candidates never imply implementation, live policy change, production mutation, or risk acceptance.
inputs: A module, its interfaces and dependencies, or evidenced architectural friction.
outputs: compatibility, migration, rollback, and test plan
responsibility: Design one module boundary and interface that hides complexity, enforces dependency direction, preserves seams, and supports migration and verification.
